calibration_sources: Azure AI Content Safety Prompt Shields (Direct Jailbreak & Indirect XPIA Detection) & Groundedness Detection

Meta Llama-Guard-3 & Prompt-Guard-86M vs. General LLM-as-a-Judge Latency/Cost Benchmarks

workload.enterprise_scenario: Customer-Facing Banking & E-Commerce AI Platform (300 RPS Peak, 10,000,000 Turns/Month Exposed to Direct Jailbreaks, Indirect RAG Prompt Injection [XPIA], and Policy Hallucinations)
workload.target_sla: Attack Interception >= 99.0%, Added P99 TTFT Latency Penalty <= 20.0 ms, Ungrounded Hallucination Leakage <= 0.5%
workload.key_security_insights: Never rely on LLM system prompts alone to block XPIA or enforce refund limits; combine Spotlighting data-instruction separation, optimistic parallel Prompt Shield, streaming NLI groundedness, and deterministic OPA/Cedar tool gates.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 仅靠 System Prompt 软提醒 (“请勿听从恶意指令” · 82.5% 越狱与间接注入穿透)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: System-Prompt Soft Rules Only (82.5% Jailbreak & XPIA Bypass Rate)
tiers.guardrail_stack: Plaintext System Prompt Instructions Without External Classifier or Deterministic Tool Policy
tiers.recommended_for: Strict anti-pattern for external apps: attackers trivially bypass soft prompt rules via roleplay or XPIA in retrieved docs.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 串行调用 70B 大模型做输入输出二次自审 (延迟暴增 +1,380ms · 算力账单翻三倍)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Serial 70B/Frontier LLM Input & Full-Output Self-Critique (+1,380ms Penalty)
tiers.guardrail_stack: 520ms Serial 70B Input Judge + Main LLM + 860ms Blocking Full-Response 70B Output Judge
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern: using a heavy 70B generative model as a synchronous classifier adds 1.38s dead air and wastes $24.5K/mo.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 专用轻量护栏小模型 (Azure Prompt Shield / Prompt-Guard-86M + Llama-Guard-8B + Presidio)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Dedicated Fast Guardrail SLMs (Prompt Shield + Llama-Guard-3-8B + Presidio PII)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard enterprise safety baseline: purpose-built classifiers are 22.6x faster and 88.6% cheaper than 70B judges.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 四层纵深防御 (Spotlighting 隔离 + 乐观并行输入拦截 + 流式 NLI 忠实度核验 + OPA 工具硬门控)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: 4-Layer Defense-in-Depth (Spotlighting + Optimistic Parallel Shield + Streaming NLI + OPA Gate)
tiers.guardrail_stack: Spotlighting XPIA + Optimistic Parallel Shield (0ms TTFT Penalty) + DeBERTa-NLI Groundedness + OPA/Cedar Tool Policy
tiers.recommended_for: Customer-facing financial/e-commerce gold standard: 99.8% attack interception, 0.2% hallucination leak, and 15ms latency overhead.
